name: Rimcazole
summary: Rimcazole is an antagonist of the sigma receptor as well as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor.

pharmacology.text: Rimcazole is an antagonist of the sigma receptor as well as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor. Trials proved inconclusive and rimcazole was not pursued for this application, but other sigma antagonists continue to be researched for a variety of potential applications. Isothiocyanate derivatives of rimcazole acting as irreversible dopamine transporter (DAT) blockers have been developed.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

sideEffects.en: It was tested in people but not marketed. Seizures were reported in trials, which is one reason its development stopped.
sideEffects.zh: 它曾在人體試驗，但未上市。試驗中有癲癇發作的報告，這也是它停止開發的原因之一。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它曾在人体试验，但未上市。试验中有癫痫发作的报告，这也是它停止开发的原因之一。

fact.en: Rimcazole was one of the first drugs tested for schizophrenia on the idea that sigma receptors might be involved, rather than dopamine receptors.
fact.zh: Rimcazole 是最早一批基於「σ 受體而非多巴胺受體可能有關」的想法，而被試驗用於思覺失調症的藥物之一。
fact.zhHans: Rimcazole 是最早一批基于「σ 受体而非多巴胺受体可能有关」的想法，而被试验用于思觉失调症的药物之一。
